Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 3D modeling reference sheet / orthographic turnaround
Primary request: Generate a clean 2x2 grid concept sheet showing four consistent orthographic views of one baseline Lunar City robotic worker droid unit. The exact four panels are: PLAN VIEW (top-down), SIDE VIEW, FRONT VIEW, and REAR VIEW. The same single droid must appear in every panel with identical proportions, silhouette, details, and scale.
Scene/backdrop: simple flat warm off-white or very light cool-gray studio sheet background; no environment, no floor scene, no extra characters, no tools or props.
Subject: friendly-looking cartoonish robotic worker droid for a lunar city. Compact utility body with rounded capsule torso, small expressive dark face panel with two simple friendly eyes, sturdy short articulated arms, chunky functional legs/feet, subtle antenna or sensor detail, simple panel seams and restrained industrial accents. Designed to be readable as a game-ready 3D asset, approachable and non-threatening.
Style/medium: polished 3D stylized character concept art, clean industrial design, soft bevels, toy-like but functional, orthographic model-sheet presentation.
Composition/framing: precise 2x2 grid with equal square panels, centered droid in each panel, full body visible with generous margins, strict orthographic alignment, no perspective distortion. Put small unobtrusive labels in each panel: “PLAN VIEW”, “SIDE VIEW”, “FRONT VIEW”, “REAR VIEW”. Keep the droid facing the same forward direction for front and rear references; side view shows true profile; plan view shows the complete footprint and arm/leg placement.
Lighting/mood: soft even studio lighting, gentle contact shadow only inside each panel, bright optimistic and friendly.
Color palette: lunar utility palette with warm white, light gray, charcoal details, muted orange-yellow safety accents, small cool cyan indicator lights.
Materials/textures: matte painted polymer or ceramic shell, brushed metal joints, rubberized feet, clean panel lines, low visual noise.
Text (verbatim): “PLAN VIEW”, “SIDE VIEW”, “FRONT VIEW”, “REAR VIEW”
Constraints: one droid only; all four views must match exactly; show the actual back in REAR VIEW rather than a mirrored front; preserve clear orthographic construction information; no weapons; no logos; no watermark; no decorative background objects.
Avoid: cinematic perspective, dynamic poses, action scene, multiple robots, humans, lunar landscape, text-heavy infographic, exploded view, blueprint line drawing, photorealism, asymmetrical proportions, inconsistent designs between panels.

Create one polished concept-art image: a strict 2x2 orthographic turnaround sheet for a single friendly cartoonish Lunar City robotic worker droid. Four equal panels, same droid and identical proportions in every panel: top-left PLAN VIEW (true top-down), top-right SIDE VIEW (true profile), bottom-left FRONT VIEW, bottom-right REAR VIEW (actual back, not mirrored front). Compact rounded utility torso, small expressive dark face panel with two friendly eyes, short articulated arms, chunky legs and feet, simple antenna/sensor, clean panel seams, warm white/light gray shell, charcoal details, muted orange-yellow safety accents, tiny cyan lights. Soft even studio lighting, flat pale warm-gray background, subtle contact shadow, full body centered with generous margins. Include only the four small labels “PLAN VIEW”, “SIDE VIEW”, “FRONT VIEW”, “REAR VIEW”. No environment, no props, no humans, no other robots, no weapons, no logo, no watermark, no perspective distortion, no dynamic pose, no blueprint style.
